items.title: OpenAI's new Rosalind Academic Plan gives research labs up to 30 free seats for a year
items.summary: OpenAI is launching the Rosalind Academic Plan, a free offering that's currently open only to research labs at US universities without an enterprise contract. The article OpenAI's new Rosalind Academic Plan gives research labs up to 30 free seats for a year appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Anthropic gives METR inside access to audit its AI models and safety practices
items.summary: Anthropic has given a team from the nonprofit METR inside access to review its AI models and safety practices, the company announced. The article Anthropic gives METR inside access to audit its AI models and safety practices appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
items.summary: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.

items.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
items.summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

items.title: Google's Gemini 4 Argon is closer to the AI frontier than any Google model in months
items.summary: Google Deepmind's Gemini 4 Argon scored 97.5 percent on the ARC-AGI-3 benchmark, making Google the second lab after OpenAI to cross the 95 percent mark. But the results swing wildly depending on the test setup: in the standard harness, the score drops to just 49.8 percent. Argon also trails rivals in math and software engineering....

items.title: Google wants Gemini 4 Argon to be the only AI model robots need
items.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Argon controls robots, generates simulations from photos or sketches, and evaluates training videos. On Google's own ERQA benchmark, it scores 87 percent. But the published example prompts show that the demos still need a lot of human guidance. The article Google wants Gemini 4 Argon to be the only AI model robots need appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: How Third Moment Research runs 10,000 agents for 36+ hours
items.summary: With GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol, Codex, and Daybreak for cybersecurity, this AI lab builds agents that focus for days and improve with use.

items.title: AI in Production: Panellists Highlight Silent Failures, Harness Engineering, and Agent Governance
items.summary: A recent InfoQ webinar examined operational challenges in deploying agentic systems. Key points included issues like semantic and embedding drift, which can lead to significant errors. Experts discussed the need for automated code reviews, continuous evaluation of models, and enhanced privacy measures. The session emphasised a strategic approach to deployment and security management. By Olimpiu Pop
